messages:
maggie: pushed a tiny NextKit sample that wires LangChain -> LlamaIndex -> our eval harness. On local + serverless it looks fine, but on edge deployments I'm hitting an auth refresh loop and the eval runner ends up timing out. repro below.

sam: can you paste the logs / quick repro steps?

maggie: sure — minimal repro: deploy the sample to an edge runtime, trigger the eval job from /api/eval. The server logs show repeated 401s then the client retries forever. snippet from server console:

```
Fetching job 12345 -> calling /v1/models/redwood-bert/generate
Request to /v1/llm failed: 401 Unauthorized
Retrying request (attempt=1)
Retrying request (attempt=2)
Error: eval job timed out after 60s
```

sam: hmm. which SDK are you using in the edge function — @redwood/js or plain fetch?

maggie: using the JS SDK (0.14.0) with the default auth helper. Edge function code uses this: 

```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.llm.generate(...)
```

and env var is set in the edge deployment.

oliver: two quick guesses: (1) SDK auto-refresh is Node-only and doesn't work in edge runtime, so the client might send an expired token and then the retry loop mis-handles the 401 -> refresh step. (2) our retry loop backoff defaults are too aggressive for eval jobs and spike more requests while token rotation is happening.

ryan: +1 on edge/auto-refresh mismatch. We had a similar bug in dedicated a while back — SDK assumed availability of secure storage for refresh tokens. For now you can force stateless auth in the sample: set REDWOOD_AUTH_STRATEGY=stateless and use a short-lived service key per-run. That avoids client-side refresh.

maggie: ok that helps as a workaround. Is there an SDK change needed so samples don't break out of the box on edge?

kai: yes — sample should detect runtime and fall back to using a server-proxy for token refresh or recommend a server-only route. Suggested README note + quick code change:

```
// in /pages/api/eval.js
if (process.env.RUNTIME === 'edge') {
  // use server proxy to avoid client refresh in edge
  return fetch(process.env.SERVER_EVAL_PROXY + '/internal/eval', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) })
}
```

Also add a note: "Edge runtimes: prefer stateless API keys or route eval through a Node server to retain refresh semantics."

devex-bot: created issue #4522: "nextkit-lite: edge auth refresh retry loop" and linked to this thread. PR template suggested.

sam: small SDK parity follow-up — we should document which features are Node-only (autoRefresh, KMS integrations) in the JS SDK README. I'll add a docs blurb.

oliver: we should also tune eval runner retry backoff to exponential with jitter and a cap, so it doesn't hammer the auth system during rotation. I can open a tiny PR for backoff math.

maggie: thanks all — I'll push a sample patch that adds the RUNTIME check + README note and add an ENV example to .env.example. pinging @sam for review.

sam: happy to review. small nit: also adjust package.json start script to make local dev match server behavior (use node server for /api routes):

```
"dev": "next dev -p 3000"
```

maggie: got it. pushing in ~30m. thanks :thumbsup:

(react: :thumbsup: from sam)
